status.burn.text: Loses 6% of its HP at the end of each turn and its Reach drops to ×0.82, for three turns.
status.poison.text: Loses 8.5% of its HP at the end of each turn, for three turns.
status.sleep.text: Skips its next move, then wakes on the one after.
status.stun.text: For its next three moves, each has a 1 in 4 chance of not happening.

card.turboslide.trait.rule: The first move it uses after it enters goes first, the way a route loads its code and data when the pointer reaches its link.
card.glyphfield.move.Editable Layers.fea: Code edits round-trip into the visual controls.
card.jarhead.trait.rule: The first hit that would take its last HP leaves it at 1 HP instead, once per match.
card.jarhead.move.Swift Hands.feature: 71 tools in ten families; the hands find a control by label, click it and check a screenshot.
card.katagami.trait.rule: Its Weight Axis move uses the weight the visitor sets on the live font, from 100 to 900: heavier hits harder and less accurately.
card.claude-of-tanks.trait.rule: Its damage has no random spread, so the same attack on the same target lands the same number unless it is critical.
card.mailroom.trait.rule: No single hit can take more than half its max HP. Past the cap, the rest of the hit is refused.
card.local-search.trait.rule: The second time it uses a move, that move goes first.
card.local-search.move.53.4 Tokens.featu: Compact results keep an agent's context short.
card.agent-pets.trait.rule: Codex plays each action three times before the pet returns to idle, so a move that hits more than once always hits three times.
card.loop.trait.rule: After every third turn it stays in play, its Reach grows, to 1.5 times and then to 2 times.
card.agent-machines.trait.rule: When it leaves play it keeps every raised stat and drops any condition, the way a machine keeps its filesystem and loses its RAM.
The provider is a setting on the machine.
card.prototemplate.trait.rule: While it waits out of play it recovers 6% of its HP each turn, the way its loops pause off screen and cost nothing.
card.prototemplate.move.Type Field.featu: Glyphs from eight scripts condense into one word that prints as real type, with its measured advance.
card.bday-land.trait.rule: A move that hits more than once always lands every hit, because a friend's throw sends every doodle on the card, up to five, and each one flies, freezes and lands.
card.bday-land.move.+999 Love.feature: A friend's blob throws the doodles from their card.
card.powerlifting.trait.rule: Both units are already in the page and CSS shows one, so a switch never flashes, and a stun never lands on it.
card.powerlifting.move.84 Icons.feature: An 84-icon pack on a 24 grid, stroke 2, mitered, with solid front-on squat, bench and deadlift.
card.elo.trait.rule: Like an Elo update, a hit on a stronger card is worth more. Its damage grows with how unlikely the hit was, with stat totals as ratings.
card.cotfly.trait.rule: The P1 population firing rate scales its throttle, so after its second turn in play its Pace grows to 1.5 times.
card.relay.trait.rule: Its hits are judged on the final state, so the other card's barrier and raised Proof do not reduce them.
card.relay.move.1v1.feature: Same task and seed, two fresh workspaces, side by side.
card.relay.move.Jev Choice.feature: Jev picks one action from a recorded menu of visible actions and returns the full probability distribution.
card.princeton-td.trait.rule: A move that hits more than once lands its scheduled number of hits every time.
The static map renders once to an offscreen canvas.
card.kevin-wiki.trait.rule: Each different move it lands adds 10% to its damage while it stays in play, up to 30%, the way each ingest adds to pages already cross-linked.
card.princeton-td.move.Cannon Shot.featu: One heavy shell that sees through half a Proof raise.
card.princeton-td.move.Traverse.feature: The turret swings onto the next lane.
card.princeton-td.move.Heavy Cannon.feat: A stabilized barrel that does not miss.
card.princeton-td.move.Flamethrower.feat: A fire stream that burns half the time.
card.princeton-td.move.Foot Soldiers.fea: Two soldiers hold the road and may dig in.
card.princeton-td.move.Dinky Guard.featu: Troops hold the line at the station.
card.princeton-td.move.Armored Troops.fe: Soldiers in armor, quicker to dig in.
card.princeton-td.move.Royal Cavalry.fea: Mounted knights that always dig in.
card.princeton-td.move.Slowing Field.fea: A slowing field that can stun.
card.princeton-td.move.Arcane Library.fe: A slowing field with magic damage.
card.princeton-td.move.EQ Smasher.featur: Seismic waves that damage and stun.
card.princeton-td.move.Blizzard.feature: Three frozen gusts that can put a foe to sleep.
card.princeton-td.move.Field Mortar.feat: A quadpod barrel with iron sights.
card.princeton-td.move.Siege Mortar.feat: A shell feeder: two shells a turn.
card.princeton-td.move.Grand Mortar.feat: A digital rangefinder and an elevation screw.
card.princeton-td.move.Missile Battery.f: A guided launcher rack that fires first.
card.princeton-td.move.Ember Foundry.fea: A triple-barrel revolver cannon that can burn.
card.princeton-td.move.Tesla Zapper.feat: Three quick bolts that strike first.
card.princeton-td.move.Capacitor.feature: The coil charges its next strike.
card.princeton-td.move.Enhanced Zapper.f: Four quick bolts that strike first.
card.princeton-td.move.Tesla Coil.featur: Five quick bolts that strike first.
card.princeton-td.move.Focused Beam.feat: A held beam that finishes a foe under 35%.
card.princeton-td.move.Chain Lightning.f: Seven quick bolts that strike first.
card.princeton-td.move.Crescendo.feature: Two notes that build toward a Reach raise.
card.princeton-td.move.Resonance.feature: Louder notes, likelier to raise Reach.
card.princeton-td.move.Forte.feature: Full voice: a Reach raise half the time.
card.princeton-td.move.Symphony Hall.fea: Three voices and a Reach raise most turns.
card.princeton-td.move.Club Dues.feature: Dues that pay back 30% of the damage.
card.princeton-td.move.Popular Dues.feat: Dues that pay back 40% of the damage.
card.princeton-td.move.Grand Dues.featur: Dues that pay back half the damage.
card.princeton-td.move.Investment Bank.f: Returns that pay back 60% of the damage.
card.princeton-td.move.Recruitment Cente: New members raise Reach half the time.
